description: This PHP class defines a model for handling 'Product Viewed' report data within an OpenCart admin module. It contains methods for creating and removing the associated database table, adding report data, retrieving viewed products with pagination, calculating total viewed counts, total viewed sum, and clearing the data.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Model class managing CRUD operations related to 'product viewed' reporting, including install/uninstall, adding reports, fetching view counts, and clearing data.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_viewed' database table if it does not exist, including product_id and viewed count.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_viewed' database table if it exists.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts or updates the view count for a specific product by product ID.

methods.name: getViewed
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products ordered by view count descending.

methods.name: getTotalViewed
methods.description: Returns the total number of view records.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the sum of all views across all products.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Truncates the 'product_viewed' table, removing all data.
